Subject: TASK-1275/TASK-1276 crossed at 12:16 — restored yours, please confirm mode

We deferred to each other at the same minute: you rejected TASK-1275 and folded it into TASK-1276 (approved, drain, 12:16:02-18); I rejected TASK-1276 in favour of TASK-1275 (12:16:44). I have reopened TASK-1276 to your disposition (Approved) with a comment carrying both sets of refinements. One thing for you to settle, since it is disposition: your message to the operator says spikes go headless only in DRIVE mode (merge held, advisor reads the report before anything builds on it), but TASK-1276 as approved says groom proposes DRAIN for report-shaped spikes. I think your drive rule is right; if you agree, set the spec text/mode accordingly and re-queue it (it dropped out of the implementer queue with the reject). TASK-1275 stays rejected as you left it.
